entries.headline: Nuclear command and transport aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a U.S. Air Force nuclear command aircraft, three heavy transport aircraft and one reconnaissance aircraft airborne over the United States, and described activity as elevated. The post did not identify callsigns or purpose.

entries.headline: North Korea mine-blast report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Reuters report saying North Korea warned South Korea of consequences for shifting blame for a mine blast. This was attributed third-party reporting, not a firsthand operational update.

entries.headline: USAF transports and command aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft over the continental United States, and described activity as elevated. No callsigns or purpose were given.

entries.headline: Gulf and Iran air activity elevated
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported U.S. military air activity near the Gulf and Iran at about four times its usual level, and also noted multiple U.S. Air Force surveillance and transport aircraft airborne. The visible post did not confirm their missions.

entries.headline: Military air activity above normal
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large military transport aircraft airborne over the United States, along with radar aircraft and command jets, and said activity was well above normal for that time of night. The post did not identify the aircraft or their purpose.

entries.headline: P4-SKN Boeing 777 sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a sighting identifying an Equatorial Guinea government Boeing 777-200LR, registration P4-SKN and hex code 48448C. The post credited @reagan0965 and a Planespotters image; it did not give a location or purpose.

entries.headline: Syrian security report relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a Jerusalem Post report stating that Syrian Internal Security Forces had disrupted a Hezbollah cell allegedly planning sabotage. The post credited @reagan0965; this was attributed third-party reporting, not a firsthand operational update.

entries.headline: E-6B Mercury sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a sighting identifying a Boeing E-6B Mercury with hex code AE041C and registration 164410; no callsign was shown. The post credited @reagan0965 and a Planespotters image, without giving a location or purpose.

entries.headline: US transports and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple U.S. military transport and command aircraft airborne over the United States, including a nuclear command aircraft, plus four coded radio broadcasts heard that day. It said the most recent broadcast was about five hours earlier but did not disclose message contents.

entries.headline: Gulf and Iran air activity elevated
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported air activity near the Gulf and Iran at nearly three times its usual level. The update also noted multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne, without identifying their purpose.

entries.headline: Command aircraft and coded traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported U.S. Air Force surveillance and nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States, plus four coded radio broadcasts heard earlier that day. It gave 17:22 UTC as the latest broadcast time but did not disclose message contents.

entries.headline: SAM218 C-32A sighting relayed
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a sighting identifying Boeing C-32A callsign SAM218 with hex code ADFEBA. The post credited TruthSeekr60 for the sighting and a Planespotters image; it did not state the aircraft’s location or purpose.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 reported on the ground at Burton
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 on the ground at Burton, Australia. The alert shows the label TRDT but does not confirm the aircraft’s mission, destination or reason for being there.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Oak Harbor, United States. The alert gives no callsign and does not confirm the aircraft’s destination or mission.

entries.headline: F/A-XX contract report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked Breaking Defense report stating that Boeing had won the U.S. Navy’s F/A-XX next-generation fighter competition. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: Second F/A-XX contract report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass separately shared a linked Aviationist report about Boeing being awarded a contract to develop the U.S. Navy’s F/A-XX fighter. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: RFR7049 P-8 departure at Alness
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported P-8 callsign RFR7049 off the ground at Alness, United Kingdom. The alert records the callsign, aircraft type and departure status without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: SNTRY60 E3TF departure at Midwest City
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported E3TF callsign SNTRY60 off the ground at Midwest City, Oklahoma. The alert records the callsign, aircraft type and departure status without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Perumbakkam
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Perumbakkam, India. The alert gives no callsign and does not confirm the aircraft’s destination or mission.

entries.headline: Geran-4 drone report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked TWZ report about Russia’s Geran-4 jet-powered attack drones and the challenge they pose to Ukrainian air defences. This was a link to third-party reporting, not a live aircraft alert.

entries.headline: F-47 production report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a linked TWZ report about Boeing’s St. Louis facility and the U.S. Air Force F-47 production program. This was third-party reporting, not a live aircraft movement alert.

entries.headline: P-8 reported at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 on the ground at Orange Park, Florida. The alert gives no callsign and does not confirm its mission or reason for landing.

entries.headline: Separate P-8 ground alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: A separate SkyGlass alert also reported a P-8 on the ground at Orange Park, Florida. With no callsign shown, the posts do not establish whether they concern the same aircraft.

entries.headline: P-8 departure at Cape Canaveral
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported a P-8 off the ground at Cape Canaveral, United States. The alert records the tracked type and departure status without confirming a destination or mission.
